description: Translate one source record into a vendor's payload in one call: Rosetta plans the mapping, compiles source_record against it and validates the result against vendor_contract (an id and the fields the vendor requires). The answer says whether the payload is ready, the plan, the payload, any skipped fields and each validation issue. Set allow_extra to let fields the contract does not list through, and extensions for vendor extensions. A plan below the confidence bar is queued for review. Needs a claimed Last Price credential. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.
